title: Ya Hussain (English Noha)
body:
YOU'RE THE SAVIOUR OF KARBALA
YOU'RE THE HELPER O HUSSAIN
YOU'RE OUR MASTER O HUSSAIN
Ya Hussain (as) Ya Hussain (as)
You are our guiding light
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
YA HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN (2)
I leave this worthless world behind
and walk towards the holy land x2
of which there is no other kind
YA HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN (2)
I stand facing the black alam
of my master Ghazi Abbas x2
pleading to be by my Molas harram
YA HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN (2)
In my heart i hold a desire
not for wealth nor for my health x2
but only to keep this burning fire
YA HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN (2)
I wish, I hope, I beg and pray
For what lies in my every vessel x2
His pain and grief to forever stay
YA HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN (2)
He blessed me with the best of eyes
He blessed me with the best of hands x2
And every part of me for Hussain cries
YA HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN (2)
I will be arriving on the elevated land
And with that my status will rise x2
As i will step foot on its purest sand
YA HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN (2)
The sands which hold the purest soul
drenched they are in pure blood x2
holding those keeping God's will their goal
YA HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN (2)
My masters Abbas and Hussain
lie resting there with millions visting x2
recalling and reliving the greatest pain
YA HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN (2)
They sacrificed all that they had
In the way of the almighty lord x2
Today for them only tears are shed
YA HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN (2)
How lucky is the sand that sleeps
with the grandson of Muhammad x2
whilst every grain for him weeps
YA HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN (2)
How fortunate is the dome that shines
above the body of Hussain x2
blessed through all the different times
YA HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN (2)
Seven letters hold such deep pain
Seven letters express only grief x2
Karbala Karbala Ya Hussain
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain (2)
Jazib and Hashim will serve you
We owe all to you, our whole life
Everything we are is through you
YA HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN (2)
